user.title: Select Mgroup panel
user.description: Select a discovered panel or enter a Bluetooth address.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Connect Mgroup panel
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up the discovered MG-P1SR-12P? Its current state will be read without switching outputs.

manual.title: Connect Mgroup panel
manual.description: Connect an MG-P1SR-12P via Bluetooth. Setup reads its status without switching outputs.

channels.title: Channel names
channels.description: Name the twelve channels. You can change these later in Configure. The hazard switch for channels 7 and 8 is added automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the panel or read its status.
error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.

init.title: Channel names
init.description: Configure channel names and shutdown requests. Turning the HA power channel off in software only fires an event. The separate request channel fires the same event when switched on. Use an automation to shut down. Physical power-off cannot be prevented.

data.strompi2_gpio21: Monitor StromPi 2 on local GPIO 21 (requires T-PIN connection)

error.same_power_and_shutdown_channel: Power and request must use different channels.
